title.zh: 【Gate 已识别并冻结与币安攻击者相关的两个账户】
title.en: 【Gate 已识别并冻结与币安攻击者相关的两个账户】

current_state.zh: Gate froze two accounts connected to the Binance attacker after roughly $250K in attacker-linked funds were deposited to the platform, and said it is cooperating with law enforcement and the ongoing investigation.
